semantics: Primary portfolio navigation is shared across pages.
Project navigation data comes from the shared navigation source, not page-local copies.
accessibility: Work menu button exposes aria-expanded and aria-haspopup.
Escape and outside pointer interaction close the menu.
constraints: Do not create a page-specific replacement header.
Do not fork mobile navigation into a separate new component.
verification: Verify keyboard Escape closes the menu.
Run TypeScript and design-system registry validation.
responsive: Check 1440px, 768px, and 390px; no document overflow. Consumer-specific layout remains local.
use_when: A portfolio page needs the global header/navigation
do_not_use_when: The surface is not part of the portfolio site
public_note: Public-safe composition adaptation. Not identical to private portfolio implementation.
